title: Graupel website configuration
description: config.json of one deployment (REQ-427). Every field is optional; missing fields take the defaults from src/config/defaults.ts. Objects are merged with the defaults field by field, arrays replace them.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema for editors.

startLocation.description: Place shown at start on the first visit; later the place shown last opens, unless the user chose another start place in the settings (REQ-599). "gps": the location picker offers the current position; GPS is only requested when the user presses the button (DEC-021), until then the first favorite preset (or the built-in default) is shown. A place: shown at start; the user can still switch to GPS. No IP location.

modelChain.description: Offer the model chain cards (weather and cloud chain). false leaves out both cards and the "Model chain" section of the settings; the chains are still loaded for the meteogram.

showWeatherChain.description: Show the weather chain card while the user has made no own choice in the settings (REQ-503). Default false. Ignored with modelChain: false.

showCloudChain.description: Show the cloud chain card while the user has made no own choice in the settings (REQ-503). Default false. Hiding it does not change what is loaded: the cloud chain still feeds the meteogram's cloud area. Ignored with modelChain: false.

modelHeaders.description: Show the model header row in the meteogram.

imageModelHeaders.description: Currently without effect, kept for later (REQ-539, DEC-094): the picture of the meteogram that is copied, saved or shared follows the model headers on screen (modelHeaders or the user's own choice in the settings). Default false.

days.description: Number of days the slider offers, or "all" for every day of the forecast.

favorites.description: Favorites tab and the favorites it starts with.

map.description: Map provider: OpenTopoMap tiles with Leaflet (default) or the Maptoolkit topo map with MapLibre (DEC-022).

languages.description: Languages offered in the language menu (REQ-423, DEC-020).

defaultLanguage.description: Fallback language when the browser language is not offered. Must be one of languages.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the domain's default place, e.g. "Europe/Vienna" (REQ-733). The model info shows the run times in the device's time zone, and in this one when the device's cannot be determined. Default "Europe/Paris" (Mont Blanc). A name the browser does not know falls back to the default.

domain.description: Domain in short form, e.g. "graupel.eu", shown in the middle of the meteogram footer (REQ-464). Without it the host name of the page is shown (without "www."; nothing on localhost or an IP address).

legal.description: Legal information of the domain (REQ-430, DEC-023). The texts themselves live in the translations.

hosting.description: Provider that actually serves the site (REQ-710); the privacy policy names it in its Hosting section and `imprint.hoster: true` shows its contact details. Default "github-pages".

label.description: Fixed label of the imprint link, e.g. "Impressum" or "Mentions légales"; without it the translated label is used.

address.description: Postal address, one entry per line.

hoster.description: Hosting provider as contact (e.g. for an anonymous imprint in France). true: the provider of legal.hosting (GitHub, Inc. by default); an object: these details, the same on every target (DEC-086).

controller.description: Controller named in the privacy policy instead of the imprint operator, with name and email only, no address (DEC-028). For a domain whose imprint stays anonymous (e.g. .fr); the imprint is not changed.

swissNotice.description: Show the section for Switzerland (revDSG, EDÖB). Default false; true only on .ch (DEC-029).

address.description: Postal address, one entry per line.
